title: Te Reo i Tae ki te Torona
intro: I whakatata atu tētahi tangata taumaha ki te nohoanga o te whakawa, e wiri ana tōna reo, ehara i te wehi, engari i te tumanako. He take whaiaro tēnei, engari ka rangona tōna whakataunga i roto i te wā, ka whakakore i tētahi tikanga tukino. Ko wai tēnei wairua i rangona tana amuamu i tua atu i ngā whetū?
clues: I haere mai ahau me te ngākau taimaha, e rapu ana i te tika mō tētahi take i herea ai tōku arero.
Kāore taku inoi i te mea ki tētahi karere anake; i kake atu ia ki tua atu, ki te Mea e whakarongo ana ki ngā mea katoa.
Ko ngā kupu i kōrerotia mōku, he rite ki ngā mekameka o mua.
I tautohe ahau, i whakaaroaro hoki, me ngā roimata me te arorau, kia mau ai tōku mana.
I heke iho tētahi whakakitenga, i whakamutua ai ngā tikanga tawhito, me te whakaae hoki ki tōku mamae.
E kiia ana ahau ko te tangata i totohe mō taku tāne, ā, ka noho tōku ingoa hei kupu whakarite mō te upoko i whakaora i ahau.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Te Wahine a Imran (Whaea o Meriama)
Te Wahine i tautohe mō tana tāne (Khawla bint Tha'laba)
Te Kuīni o Sheba (Bilqis)
Te Whaea o Mohi
Te Wahine a Parao (Āhiah)
identity.answer: Te Wahine i tautohe mō tana tāne (Khawla bint Tha'laba)

trial.label: Te Whakamātautau, te Takahanga rānei
options: I whakapaetia teka ia mō te puremu
He pakoko ia, ā, i hiahia ia ki tētahi tamaiti
I pāngia ia e te tikanga whakarere tukino
He kuīni ia e kōrero tahi ana me tētahi poropiti
I huna e ia tana tamaiti i te ringa o te rangatira
trial.answer: I pāngia ia e te tikanga whakarere tukino

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: He kuao kau koura
He torona whakahīhī
Te mahi a Zihar
He kete i te awa
He oati tapu mō te whakatapua

outcome.label: Hua
options: I manaakitia ia ki te tamaiti i tōna koroheketanga
I whakaorangia ia i te toremitanga
I whiwhi ia i tētahi whakakitenga atua e whakakore ana i te tikanga
I riro ia hei kuīni i muri i tētahi whakamātautau
I whakawhiwhia ia ki tētahi tama, ā, i riro hei poropiti
outcome.answer: I whiwhi ia i tētahi whakakitenga atua e whakakore ana i te tikanga

arabic: قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَـٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verse: Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing. (58:1)
